variableDeclarations.name: auth_ctx
variableDeclarations.description: Monotonic customer identity verification and step-up authorization context.

authenticated.description: True only after server-verified primary authentication succeeds.

pin_locked.description: True if telephone or banking PIN is locked due to failed attempts.

step_up_completed.description: True only after strong 2FA step-up challenge verification succeeds.

variableDeclarations.name: cards_ctx
variableDeclarations.description: Credit card selection, lifecycle status, and limit modification state.

card_status.description: Current operational status of the selected credit card.

limit_error_code.description: Latest error or eligibility code returned by card limit BFA.

requested_limit_eur.description: Customer-requested credit card limit in EUR.

selected_card_last4.description: Masked last four digits of the selected credit card.

variableDeclarations.name: consent_ctx
variableDeclarations.description: EU AI Act Art. 50 disclosure and recording consent tracking state.

ai_disclosure_shown.description: True once the required EU AI Act Art. 50 disclosure has been delivered.

recording_state.description: Current call or transcript recording state.

variableDeclarations.name: disabled_agent_authentication_agent
variableDeclarations.description: Flat scalar operational kill-switch mirror for authentication_agent.

variableDeclarations.name: disabled_agent_branch_information_agent
variableDeclarations.description: Flat scalar operational kill-switch mirror for branch_information_agent.

variableDeclarations.name: disabled_agent_credit_cards_agent
variableDeclarations.description: Flat scalar operational kill-switch mirror for credit_cards_agent.

variableDeclarations.name: disabled_agent_guide_agent
variableDeclarations.description: Flat scalar operational kill-switch mirror for guide_agent.

variableDeclarations.name: disabled_agent_human_interaction_agent
variableDeclarations.description: Flat scalar operational kill-switch mirror for human_interaction_agent.

variableDeclarations.name: disabled_agent_sepa_transfer_agent
variableDeclarations.description: Flat scalar operational kill-switch mirror for sepa_transfer_agent.

variableDeclarations.name: segment
variableDeclarations.description: Flat scalar mirror of session_ctx.segment for runtime CEL condition evaluation.

variableDeclarations.name: session_ctx
variableDeclarations.description: Server-initialized session routing, brand, modality, surface, segment, and runtime kill-switch context.

authentication_agent.description: Emergency runtime kill-switch flag for authentication specialist.

branch_information_agent.description: Emergency runtime kill-switch flag for branch servicing specialist.

credit_cards_agent.description: Emergency runtime kill-switch flag for credit card specialist.

guide_agent.description: Emergency runtime kill-switch flag for general knowledge specialist.

human_interaction_agent.description: Emergency runtime kill-switch flag for human handover specialist.

sepa_transfer_agent.description: Emergency runtime kill-switch flag for SEPA transfer specialist.

disabled_agents.description: Runtime emergency kill-switch flags keyed by specialist identifier.

handoff_ref_token.description: Warm human escalation correlation reference token.

segment.description: Customer servicing segment identifier (mass or employee).

surface_id.description: Entry surface identifier (call-center, mobile-app, public-web, olb).

variableDeclarations.name: surface_id
variableDeclarations.description: Flat scalar mirror of session_ctx.surface_id for runtime CEL condition evaluation.

variableDeclarations.name: transfer_ctx
variableDeclarations.description: SEPA credit transfer preparation and finality confirmation state.

amount_eur.description: Requested SEPA credit transfer amount in EUR.

masked_account_id.description: Masked destination account ID for customer confirmation.

recipient_name.description: Beneficiary name for the SEPA credit transfer.

sepa_finality_ack.description: True when the customer explicitly confirms irreversible SEPA execution.
